name: Klotho
description: Protein made by the body; one form sits in the cell membrane and another circulates in blood

status.humanEvidence: Lab or animal only; levels measured in people

note.text: Human data link blood levels or gene variants with health. Two small klotho gene-therapy pilots have posted no results.

bullets: **Mice lacking klotho** aged early and died young (1997)
**Circulating klotho** dampened insulin and IGF-1 signalling, in a mouse study
**One injection** improved memory tests in old monkeys at a low dose only
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Mouse, rat and one monkey study
No study gave klotho protein to people

practical.monitored: Not established (protein never given to people)

regulatory.text: Not approved; not on compounding lists
Not named; S0 bans unapproved substances

references: Nature Aging, klotho injection and memory in old rhesus monkeys, Jul 2023
Science, suppression of aging in mice by the hormone klotho, Sep 2005
